data_fields.name: explicit drop chance (per entry)
data_fields.donor_constant: percent 0-100, one draw in [0,100) walked across the group

data_fields.name: group loot threshold quality
data_fields.donor_constant: items below group threshold quality skip the roll

best_idea: One draw walks the cumulative chances of mutually exclusive drops, with a uniform equal-chance pool for the rest, and filtering is stated as a rule rather than left to renormalise.
decision_why: The one-draw table is simple, server-side and checkable, so take the shape; do not copy the donor's group/quality inconsistency or silent overflow, and defer the Need/Greed party UI until a party rule exists.
acceptance: A server test over 100k seeded rolls on one zone table (explicit chances 10 and 25, plus an equal-chance item) lands each within 0.5 points of its chance; a kill payload carries one pick per group and never more than 18 stacks, with overflow written to the ledger.
